verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a consumer or Workspace AI research app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only analytics mention (docs-9) describes owners viewing usage analytics for their public notebooks, which is a different feature, not a user privacy control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
